description: Runtime exports of the maintenance-mode ait-rn adapter and their WebView SDK 3 replacements. reexportsFrom names the subpaths whose exports an entry re-exports, so root imports resolve to the owning module. packages/ait-web/test/migration-map.test.ts keeps this file exact; scripts/check-consumer-webview-migration.mjs reads it.

ad-skip.note: Shared through ait-core. Keep the persisted request-ID storage key unchanged so an in-flight redemption reconciles after the cutover.

ads.note: Pass loadSdk: () => import('@apps-in-toss/web-framework') from the consumer module. The runtime helpers that ait-rn/ads re-exports from ait-rn/runtime are re-exported from ait-web/ads the same way.

analytics.note: SDK 3 has Analytics.log but no RN Analytics.init logger hook. Supply an explicit mapEvent; only sanitized scalar params reach the SDK.

diagnostics.note: Same opt-in ait-runtime-diagnostics-v1 snapshot as RN. It reports only normalized values and never invokes login, ads, consent or purchases.

engagement.note: Drive foreground and exposure state from document visibility and the viewport instead of RN AppState.

ensureAppsInTossHapticFallback.use: Remove it. The RN NativeModules fallback has no WebView counterpart; call generateHapticFeedback from @apps-in-toss/web-framework.

haptics.note: No kit wrapper is planned; the official SDK 3 call is the replacement.

createAppsInTossIapBridge.use: ait.purchase, ait.subscribe, ait.getProducts and ait.getSubscriptionInfo for purchases, and createAppsInTossIapRestoreBridge() from ait-web/iap for restorePendingOrders and completeProductGrant with the same options, results and error codes.

iap.note: The backend grant client, error class and pending-order restore loop are shared through ait-core. Keep the backend verification ledger authoritative; SDK success events are UI results, not proof of payment or entitlement. Acknowledge an order with completeProductGrant only after the backend persisted its grant.

APPS_IN_TOSS_ANONYMOUS_HASH_PREFIX.use: ait.anonymousHash() already returns the ait: form; WebView authentication uses fresh codes instead.

DEFAULT_APPS_IN_TOSS_ANONYMOUS_HASH_STOR.use: Never send a stored anonymous hash for WebView authentication; request a fresh ait.createAnonymousKeyAuthCode() for each bootstrap. createAppsInTossWebSessionStorage() keeps the hash only to notice an account change on the device.

DEFAULT_APPS_IN_TOSS_APP_SESSION_STORAGE.use: If the RN app stored sessions under this default key, pass storage: createAppsInTossSdkStorageBridge() (verbatim keys) with appSessionStorageKey: 'trailbase.appSession' and anonymousHashStorageKey: 'trailbase.anonymousHash' to createAppsInTossWebSessionStorage(); ait.storage would prefix them with the appKey.

createAppsInTossIdentityStorage.use: createAppsInTossWebSessionStorage() from ait-web/storage. It applies the same account check to the session keys before the trailbase-client session manager restores them.

isAppsInTossAnonymousHash.use: Not needed for WebView authentication; the backend exchanges a fresh code and derives the identity server-side.

resolveAppsInTossAnonymousHash.use: ait.createAnonymousKeyAuthCode() (SDK 3.6+), exchanged once by the backend through the private proxy. Never fall back to a client hash.

identity.note: Requires a proxy that reports the anonymous-key.exchange-auth-code capability. Keep the legacy hash bootstrap route enabled only until the RN bundle is retired.

isAppsInTossInlineAdSupported.use: createWebViewBannerAds() from ait-web/ads; treat an initialize or attach failure as unsupported and keep the slot collapsed.

inline-ads.note: The placeholder policy is shared through ait-core. The RN InlineAd component becomes a DOM target owned by the consumer: attach only while the slot is visible and destroy the handle on unmount.

createAppsInTossLoginBridge.use: ait.login(); exchange the one-time code and its unchanged referrer through the backend. SANDBOX is still a real code.

login.note: Toss Login links live in the backend, so an account linked from RN stays linked after the WebView bootstrap resolves the same TrailBase user.

notifications.note: Request agreement through ait.requestNotificationAgreement(), then sync its result with the shared functional message client, which only calls app-owned backend endpoints. The adapter throws WebAdapterError; the client throws AppsInTossNotificationAgreementError.

promotion.note: Platform-neutral backend clients shared through ait-core. The backend keeps promotion codes and the proxy call.

runtime.note: Reads the SDK 3 Environment and Device namespaces instead of the deprecated top-level getters. A thrown, missing or unexpected value is unknown, never production. Pass loadSdk: () => import('@apps-in-toss/web-framework') from the consumer module.

share.note: The WebView createAppsInTossShareBridge takes loadSdk: () => import('@apps-in-toss/web-framework') from the consumer module. A resolved share sheet is not evidence of sharing and never authorizes a reward.

shopping.note: Platform-neutral link validation shared through ait-core. Inject openURL from @apps-in-toss/web-framework into createAppsInTossShoppingBridge.

createAppsInTossSessionStorage.use: createAppsInTossWebSessionStorage() from ait-web/storage with storage: ait.storage and resolveAnonymousHash: ait.anonymousHash. It reads the `${appKey}.appSession`, `${appKey}.tossSession` and `${appKey}.anonymousHash` keys the RN helper wrote, and clears both sessions instead of restoring them when the Toss account changed. Do not read session keys through plain ait.storage.

storage.note: Do not double-prefix keys: use ait.storage with short names, or the raw bridge with the full RN key. Verify on a device that the WebView bundle reads values the RN bundle wrote.
